message.text: There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is protobuf-defined gRPC services with gRPC-Gateway REST and Connect. Proto files define the service contracts. openapi.yaml describes the REST surface. v1.go registers the endpoints.

r05.
There is no GraphQL schema or GraphQL API.

The public API is protobuf gRPC (AIP-style) under `proto/api/v1/*.proto`, with generated OpenAPI at `proto/gen/openapi.yaml`. The server exposes it via gRPC-Gateway REST and Connect (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`).
